summary: The candidate only raises the bumpRateLimit retry bound from 8 to 10 and adds a concurrent regression test. The rate limiter already used a versionstamp-checked atomic commit at the base commit, so the change introduces no functional defect and the added test is a valid, deterministic guard that would also pass against the base implementation.

evidence: The base blob 8e18327 for src/auth_store.ts already implements bumpRateLimit as a get followed by store.atomic().check(result).set(key, next, { expireIn: windowMs }).commit(), retrying only when the versionstamp check fails, so concurrent callers cannot all spend the same remaining slot.
The atomic fix entered history in commit 7e879bd, an ancestor of base 01ad03d, so the race described in the issue no longer exists at the base commit.

The candidate diff changes only the retry bound 8 to 10 and adds the 50-request / limit 5 regression test in tests/bun_test.ts; the test exercises the unchanged base implementation and would pass there too, confirming the change is a guard rather than the fix.
Window behavior is preserved in the retry path since windowStart is retained and expireIn stays windowMs, satisfying the expiry acceptance criterion at base.
